verdict.rationale: Statsig is a feature-flag and experimentation SaaS, not an agent, so the official-MCP-server axis applies. Its docs describe an official Statsig MCP server that plugs into Codex, Cursor, Claude Code and ChatGPT, and a probe confirmed the dedicated docs page exists. missing for 10: documented tool/capability list exposed by the server, setup and authentication details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: The Statsig MCP (Model Context Protocol) server brings the power of Statsig into tools like Codex, Cursor, and Claude Code.
Talk to your Statsig projects from within ChatGPT.
official MCP server documented at https://docs.statsig.com/mcp
